en.headline: Observatory monitors Tropical Storm Narra for possible signals midweek
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said Narra is expected to linger over Beibu Wan before turning northeast towards the Leizhou Peninsula, with an assessment of tropical cyclone warning signals on Tuesday or Wednesday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said Tropical Storm Narra was centred about 240 kilometres west-northwest of Haikou at 10 p.m. on Sunday and is forecast to remain slow-moving over the vicinity of Beibu Wan today and Monday.

The system is then expected to turn gradually northeast later on Monday and Tuesday, edging closer to the Leizhou Peninsula at the southwestern tip of Guangdong. The Observatory will closely monitor its movement and local wind conditions and assess the need to issue tropical cyclone warning signals on Tuesday or Wednesday.

A broad trough of low pressure is already bringing showers and squally thunderstorms to the northern South China Sea and the Guangdong coast. The local forecast calls for mainly cloudy conditions with a few showers and thunderstorms tonight and tomorrow, with showers increasing gradually and temperatures between 27 and 31 degrees Celsius.
Tropical Depression Gaenari, located near Taipei, is expected to move west-southwest across the Taiwan Strait and dissipate gradually, posing limited direct threat to Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 天文台密切監察熱帶風暴紫檀 周二或周三或發熱帶氣旋警告
zh.dek: 天文台表示紫檀預料於北部灣徘徊後轉向東北靠近雷州半島，會評估周二或周三是否需要發出熱帶氣旋警告信號。
body: 香港天文台表示，周日晚上10時熱帶風暴紫檀集結在海口西北偏西約240公里，預料今明兩日於北部灣一帶徘徊，移動緩慢。
其後於星期一稍後至星期二逐漸轉向東北方向移動，靠近雷州半島一帶。天文台會密切監察其動向及本地風力變化，評估星期二或星期三是否需要發出熱帶氣旋警告信號。
一道廣闊低壓槽正為南海北部及廣東沿岸帶來驟雨及狂風雷暴。本港今晚及明日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及狂風雷暴，明日驟雨逐漸增多，氣溫介乎27至31度。
位於台北附近的熱帶低氣壓簡拉維預料向西南偏西移動，於台灣海峽一帶逐漸消散，對本港直接威脅不大。
